day_local: Jimcaha Toddobaadka Afraad iyo Labaatanaad ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jirto.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
psalm_response: Rabbiyow, markay ammaantaadu muuqato, farxaddaydu way buuxsami doontaa.
homily:
Waxaan rabaa inaan maanta idinla wadaago sawir yar oo maskaxdayda ku soo dhacaya marka aan ka fikiro nolosha Benjamin Vo. Waxaan arkaa Ben oo fadhiya guriga, isagoo si taxaddar leh u dhisaya aalad ama koodh kumbuyuutar, isagoo si qoto dheer ugu dhex milmay dunida tiknoolajiyadda. Wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay sida loo arko waxyaabaha aan la arki karin, sida loo fahmo qoto dheerida xogta iyo xiriirka ka dhexeeya qaybaha yaryar ee adduunkeenna. Laakiin waxaa jiray wax ka sii qoto dheer aqoontiisa: waxay ahayd awoodda uu u lahaa inuu wax bixiyo, inuu u naxariisto, iyo inuu jacaylkiisa u muujiyo si fudud oo aan buunbuunin lahayn.

Akhriska koowaad ee maanta, Bawlos wuxuu inoo sheegayaa xaqiiqo naxdin leh haddii aynaan rumaysnayn sarakicidda: 'Haddii Masiixu aanu sara kicin, rumaysadkiinnu waa wax aan micne lahayn.' Tani waa tiirka nolosheenna. Markaan eegno dhimashada Benjamin, waxaan dareemaynaa in dunidu ay mararka qaarkood u muuqato mid aan macno lahayn. Laakiin Bawlos wuxuu inoo sheegayaa in Masiixu uu yahay 'midhaha ugu horreeya' ee kuwa hurda. Tani macnaheedu waa in Ben aanu dhiman, laakiin uu u gudbay nolol ka sii weyn, nolol aan xanuun lahayn, nolol uu hadda ku arkayo wajiga Ilaah.

Injiilka maanta wuxuu inoo sheegayaa in Ciise uu mar walba safar ku jiray, isagoo wada dad ay ka mid yihiin Maryan Magdala iyo Joanna. Waxay ahaayeen dad u adeegayay Ciise 'iyagoo ka bixinaya khayraadkooda.' Benjamin wuxuu lahaa qalbi noocaas ah. Xusuuso sheekadii ahayd markuu rabay inuu bixiyo lacagta sanduuqiisa yar si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn, laakiin rabitaankaas safka hore kaga jiray ee ahaa inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto waa xigmadda dhabta ah ee Masiixu inoo sheegayo. Ben wuxuu baray qoyskiisa in jacaylku aanu ahayn waxa aad haysato, laakiin waa waxa aad diyaar u tahay inaad bixiso.

Alan iyo Thao, waxaan ogahay in saddexdan bilood ay idinku noqdeen kuwo culus oo aamusnaan ka buuxdo. Waxaan ogahay in habeenkii, marka aad eegto sawirrada Ben ee uu ku jiro dhoolacaddayntiisa quruxda badan, aad is-weydiinaysaan: 'Maxaynu seegnay? Ma jirtay wax aynu si kale u samayn karin?' Waxaan rabaa inaan maanta dhex fadhiisto xanuunkaas idinkala socda oo aan idiin sheego si cad: Waxba ma aad seegin. Ma jiro qof eed leh. Xanuunka iyo dhimashada aan la fileynin ee soo martay Ben ma aha ciqaab, mana aha guuldarro waalid. Sida Ciise ugu jawaabay markii la weydiiyay sababta uu ninku u dhashay indhoolaha: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Ilaah ma eedeeyo, mana aha in aad adinkuna is-eedaysaan. Jacaylka aad Ben siisateen—sheekooyinkii Alan, xanaanadii Thao—wuxuu ahaa nuurka dhabta ah ee noloshiisa. Sida Ben u lahaa qalbiyada deeqda ah, sidaas oo kale ayaad adinkuna u bixiseen jacayl buuxa.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waxaan ogahay inaysan fududayn inaad lumiso saaxiibkaaga, walaalkaa, kii aad la wadaagaysay adduunka. Laakiin Ben wuxuu kaa doonayaa inaad sii waddo socodka, inaad noolaato adigoo geesinimo leh, adigoo xusuusanaya in xiriirka idinka dhexeeya uusan dhiman. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay meel nabdoon. Wuxuuna idin leeyahay: 'Haku murugoonina si xad dhaaf ah; waan idin daawanayaa.'

Markaad ka baxaysaan meeshan maanta, qaado hal shay oo yar: Ha ku tiirsanaan xigmaddaada marka culaysku yimaado. U dhiib qalbigaaga Ciise. Ha joojiso inaad is-eedeyso. Ogow in Ben uu ku jiro nabadda iyo gacmaha Aabbaha, oo uu halkaas idinku sugayo. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad joogto Sakramenti Quduuska ah. Waxaan ku jeclahay wax kasta oo aan ahay, waxaana rabaa inaan ku qaato naftayda. Maadaama aanan hadda kuu qaadan karin si muuqata, fadlan igu soo gal si ruuxi ah qalbigayga. Waxaan ku duubayaa naftayda adiga, oo marnaba ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa fogaado. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin ilaaliyo, oo ha idin siiyo nabad iyo rajo maanta iyo weligiin. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: Rabbiyow, waxaan kuu baryaynaa Benjamin Vo iyo dhammaan kuwa naga hor maray, inuu Rabbigu ku aqbalo iftiinka wajigiisa oo uu siiyo nabad weligeed ah.
Rabbiyow, waxaan kuu baryaynaa dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan, gaar ahaan qoyska Benjamin, inuu Ilaah qalbiyadooda u dejiyo nabad iyo rajo, si ay u helaan xoog ay ku sii wadaan nolosha.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Walaalayaal, haddii Masiixu inuu ka sara kacay kuwii dhintay la wacdiyey, sidee bay qaarkiin u leeyihiin, Dhimashada sarakiciddeedu ma jirto? Haddii aanay dhimashada sarakiciddeedu jirin, markaas Masiixuba sara kamuu kicin. Haddii aan Masiixu sara kicin, markaas wacdigeennu waa wax aan micne lahayn, rumaysadkiinnuna waa wax aan micne lahayn. Sidoo kale, waxaanu noqonaynaa markhaatiyaal been ah oo Ilaah ka hor, waayo, waxaanu Ilaah ka marag kacnay inuu Masiixa sara kiciyey, kii aanu sara kicin haddii ay run tahay inaanay dhimashada sarakiciddeedu jirin. Waayo, haddii aanay kuwa dhintay sara kicin, Masiixuba sara kamuu kicin. Haddii aan Masiixu sara kicin, rumaysadkiinnu waa wax aan micne lahayn, welina dembiyadiinnii baad ku jirtaan. Markaas kuwa ku dhintay Masiixu way baabba'een. Haddii aanu Masiixan rajada ka qabno noloshan oo keliya, waxaannu nahay kuwa ugu liita dadka oo dhan. Laakiin hadda Masiixu wuu ka sara kacay kuwii dhintay, isagoo ah midhaha ugu horreeya ee kuwa dhintay.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Intaas ka dib, Ciise wuxuu marayey magaalooyin iyo tuulooyin, isagoo wacdiyaya oo ku dhawaaqaya injiilka boqortooyada Ilaah. Waxaa la socday laba iyo tobankii, iyo haween qaarkood oo jinniyo xun iyo cudurro laga bogsiiyey, kuwaas oo kala ahaa Maryan oo la odhan jiray Magdala, tii ay toddoba jinni ka bexeen, iyo Yooxanna oo ahayd naagtii Cuuza oo ahaa wakiilkii Herodos, iyo Suusanna, iyo kuwo kale oo badan oo iyaga ka caawin jiray khayraadkooda.

day: Friday of the Twenty-fourth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm
